content.text: Submitted. The repaired fallback proposal now makes two minimal edits: (1) swapping "the Term" for "the then-current twelve (12) month period" inside the existing sentence (passes the 0.600 gate), and (2) one concise inserted sentence giving us reduction on 30 days' notice with an equitable true-up instead of a shortfall penalty. The redundant no-charge sentence, "or similar charge", and "prior written" formality were removed.
